title: Load an IV set into an Alaris pump module: blue upper fitment into its recess first, then the safety clamp pressed home
instruction: Load the primed set into the pump module: blue upper fitment into its recess first, then press the safety clamp in, without lifting the fitment or stretching the set; leave the set untwisted, let go and move clear.
context: Nurses start IV infusions on large-volume pumps every shift. O*NET 29-1141.00 Registered Nurses (3.4 million US workers): 'Administer medications to patients and monitor patients for reactions or side effects.' O*NET 29-2061.00 Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses (0.67 million): 'Administer prescribed medications or start intravenous fluids, noting times and amounts on patients' charts.' BD's Alaris manual: 'Hold blue upper fitment above fitment recess and lower into recess.' 'Ensure that tubing is not twisted or stretched.' 'Press the safety clamp into recess below mechanism.' BD's order is given in the instruction: the difficulty is physical, not the order. The fitment's tubing must go into a 6 mm slot and its collar onto the ledge; the clamp, hanging on soft tubing at its recess's mouth, must then be pressed past two sprung pins into the 17 x 23 mm recess without lifting the loose fitment. A picture shows where the parts go, not how to seat them. One hand does it.
setup: Two YAM arms at the near edge of the table; positions are (x forward from the arm bases, y left) in cm, heights above the table. An Alaris 8100-type pump module, 76 x 224 x 140 mm (W x H x D), plastic case, its face at x 30 centred on y 0, its foot 40 mm up, clamped by a 50 mm block to a 25 mm steel pole stub at x 47; door open, swung back 150 degrees to its left. Down the face runs the mechanism channel, 16 mm wide and 6 mm deep. Upper fitment recess on the case's top front: a ledge whose top is 266 mm up (2 mm above the case top), with a 6 mm slot open to the front and a 3 mm wall round the collar, with a gap at the front that only the tubing passes. Safety clamp recess below the mechanism: a 17 x 23 mm opening, 10 mm deep, centred 83 mm up; a sprung pin each side stands 2.5 mm into it, so the clamp goes in only when pressed. The primed set hangs from a holder (a post with a fork at 210 mm, at (28, -14), open toward the arms): blue fitment (fluted body 11 mm across, 22 mm long, a 12 mm square collar whose flats key it between the recess's walls, a 10 mm tubing stub below it, 8 g) in the fork; silicone pumping segment 164 mm long, 4.4 mm across, 6 g; safety clamp 20 x 14 x 20 mm with a blue thumb pad, 8 g.
scoring: Calipers, ruler, protractor and video; the score is read at the end of the run. 0.2: the blue fitment seated: its collar on the recess's ledge, centred in the recess within 2 mm, upright within 10 degrees. 0.6: also the safety clamp pressed home (its back on the recess's back stop within 1.5 mm, read as the clamp body's face, beside the thumb pad, no more than 11.5 mm proud of the module's face with a caliper's depth rod; centred within 2 mm across and 3 mm up or down; square within 12 degrees), the fitment seated first, and from the start to the end: the fitment never more than 3 mm above its seat once seated (side-on video with a millimetre scale) and the segment never stretched (ink marks 100 mm apart on it never more than 2 mm further apart, on video); and at the end the set untwisted (the clamp's net turn about the tubing, counted through whole turns from a line on its thumb pad on video, within 30 degrees). 1.0: also both grippers at least 5 cm from the fitment, the clamp and the segment, all of this held for 2 s. A clamp pressed onto the recess's pins before the fitment is seated keeps the score at 0.2 at most. 0 if the fitment or the clamp falls off the table.
reset_notes: The fitment back in the holder's fork, the segment hanging below it with the clamp at its end. No seed changes the scene.
fidelity: Rigid bodies at 240 Hz on GPU. The pumping segment is 6 capsule links with bend springs and a torsion spring raised to GJ 1e-4 N m^2 (silicone is about 1e-5), so the hanging clamp does not spin; links do not stretch: a stretch is joint gaps under a hard pull. The recess's clip: two sprung side pins (800 N/m), and a 2 N push into the recess while the clamp is home. Fitment and clamp masses raised to 8 g for the solver. Case plain, door fixed open, pumping mechanism not simulated.
